note: Rustic Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest campground on the south end of 66-acre Starrett Lake (electric motors only, slow-no-wake), with good swimming, a turnaround boat landing, paved campground roads and an attendant mid-May to mid-October. A designated quiet campground: no generators or loud electronics. --Claude
summary: DNR rustic page + 2025 brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread. 42 sites (36 drive-in, 6 walk-to tent), no electricity, 4 vault toilets + 3 hand pumps, reservation-only. WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview (continuous canopy; no pad seen on open ground). Pin ~90 m from DNR GPS (fine). Season manual kept (2027 Columbus Day = Oct 11). Website 404 -> NHAL rustic page.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview: the DNR map (not to scale) draws the west loop's 1301 and 1304-1308 and the east loop's 1336-1338 near the south shore, but on Esri and NAIP the whole campground is unbroken pine/hardwood canopy from the shoreline back; no pad, loop road or open ground to the water can be seen (the only opening is the boat-landing turnaround at the southwest cove, ~46.0247,-89.5755). Nothing confirms a site within ~50 m over open ground; the shoreline sites drawn on the map support at most a view through trees. Stored lakefront cannot be kept under the evidence gate. All sites are reservable by the night.
SEASON (manual, not written): stored 04-30..10-14 'Approximate: the DNR says April 30 to Columbus Day' - the DNR still says that; Columbus Day 2027 is Oct 11, so 2027 dates are 04-30..10-11.
